reviews.review_text:
Rich
Beach Lake, Pennsylvania135 contributions
0
A great rooftop experience, and not overpriced
Feb 2015 • Business
We were guests at the hotel, which is why we went upstairs to check out the rooftop bar/restaurant. We expected to find a typical rooftop menu of incredibly overpriced drinks, making us feel like we were stuck in a tourist trap, but this one is different. Drinks are priced comparably to drinks on the street (say, at any restaurant with wifi and a/c, not just any roadside stall). Food was pretty good too. 

It might seem touristy to walk into a hotel and go order drinks on the roof...but for these reasonable prices, go for it. Even if you just have a beer and snap some photos of the skyline, it's not going to break the bank. Enjoy!
